items.title: Percy Gabriel Interview, 1987-07-10
items.q: Yes, I recorded with Mike Shan, yeah.

ctx.x: If he used anything, he didn't let me see him do it.
Maybe, Dick, we talk about recordings because you played with so many different bands. Did you ever record with Jamie Shan? Yes, I recorded with Mike Shan, yeah.
Yeah, I did about... What tracks, I mean, what songs you did?
